guide: [[@2611.32203|OmniEVIE]] 的关键是训练时就按索引形态聚类，压缩后的多向量索引反而比直接截维更好，百万库单线程查询 54 ms。[[@2611.32917|SOARS]] 发现深度搜索 Agent 的瓶颈常常不在召回，而是答案文档排得太靠后、Agent 没点开，每步加一次 250 毫秒的重排就能同时提准确率、减搜索次数。[[@2611.32125|LARF]] 读的时候注意区分 8B 和线上 1.7B 的数字：**线上那个模型离线只比基线高 0.6 点**。[[@2611.32660|Bathys]] 说明 rollout 中途压缩历史时，普通 GSPO 等于白跑，要按压缩边界切段算梯度。

[[@2611.32855|SIDECAR]] 用草稿加树注意力验证替代 beam search，还能给出离精确 top-K 差多少的保证，线上可以按质量或延迟阈值提前停。[[@2611.32590|LazUnirec]] 在同一个 Transformer 里统一召回和排序，用 LoRA 调制注意力和稀疏 MoE 缓解两个任务的梯度冲突，已经上线。[[@2611.33240|教育推荐离线评测]]发现只看上一个活动的结构预测器就能达到最好方法 95% 的准确率，**离线指标测到的多半是平台的排课逻辑**。[[@2611.32908|KuroANN]] 按每个 query 通过过滤的向量数分配读盘量，比 PipeANN-Filter 最多快 34.5 倍；[[@2611.31882|RELAY]] 让换 embedding 模型时新旧向量能共存打分，不用整库重建。

papers.title: OmniEVIE: Evidence-Vector-Informed Embedding for Multi-modal Retrieval
papers.title_zh: 多向量检索索引压到每条 9.4 KB，精度几乎不掉
papers.affiliation: 腾讯（IMA 产品中心、优图实验室）
papers.summary_zh: OmniEVIE用压缩多向量索引统一文本、图像、文档、视频与工具检索。
papers.abstract_zh: 多模态检索需要匹配信息密集的页面、细粒度实体、有时序的视频，以及 Agent 的工具与记忆。单向量 embedding 会丢失局部证据，cross-encoder 要在线重读每个召回项，未压缩的[[late-interaction|late interaction]]又大到无法部署。我们提出 OmniEVIE，一个 4.5B 的==多向量 embedding 模型==，用一个压缩索引和一个==三阶段检索器==覆盖文本、图像、视觉文档、视频和工具。每条记录最多存储 128 个 64 维 int8 向量（9,472 字节，每百万条 8.82 GiB），从中得到均值向量、1-bit 符号和 int8 多向量，分别用于粗筛、中筛和最终检索，同时把每个命中定位到页面区域或视频时间段。训练、合并、索引和检索是协同设计的：所有任务共用一种检索格式；三级证据检查去除[[false-negative|假负例]]；动态采样依据基线模型与教师模型之间的差距；训练时就用 ==ST-HAC== 压缩候选，与索引形态保持一致；分阶段模型与专家模型按参数块合并；带噪声下限的显著性门控改进 query 侧打分。仅用公开数据训练，OmniEVIE 在 MMEB-V3（190 个任务）上得分 60.68（完整 d=2048 序列）和 60.06（K128×d64 int8 索引），在 MMEB-V2（78 个任务）上为 77.96，在 ViDoRe V3（48 个任务）上为 62.96。在 100 万和 500 万条记录上，单线程查询分别耗时 54.2 ms 和 120.2 ms，**比精确的 4096 维单向量检索快 11.1 倍和 25.3 倍，比完整 int8 MaxSim 快 236 倍和 532 倍**。视频直接从帧编码，无需视频解析模型：在 QVHighlights（1,083 个 query）上，78.0% 的 query 热度峰值落在标注片段内，**返回的片段（平均占视频长度 18%）有 94.3% 与标注片段相交，同长度随机片段为 44.9%**。权重与代码：https://huggingface.co/tencent/OmniEVIE-4B 和 https://github.com/Tencent/OmniEVIE。
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal retrieval must match dense pages, fine-grained entities, ordered video, and agent tools and memory. Single-vector embeddings lose local evidence, cross-encoders reread every recalled item online, and uncompressed late interaction is too large to serve. We present OmniEVIE, a 4.5B multi-vector embedding model covering text, images, visual documents, video, and tools with one compressed index and a three-stage retriever. Each record stores at most 128 int8 vectors of dimension 64 (9,472 bytes, or 8.82 GiB per million records), providing a mean vector, 1-bit signs, and int8 multi-vectors for coarse, middle, and final search while localizing each hit to a page region or video interval. Training, merging, indexing, and retrieval are co-designed: all tasks share one retrieval format, a three-grade evidence check removes false negatives, dynamic sampling follows the baseline-teacher gap, candidates are compressed with ST-HAC during training to match the index, stage-wise and specialist models are merged by parameter block, and a saliency gate with a noise floor refines query scoring. Trained on public datasets, OmniEVIE scores 60.68 (full d=2048 sequence) and 60.06 (K128 x d64 int8 index) on MMEB-V3 (190 tasks), 77.96 on MMEB-V2 (78 tasks), and 62.96 on ViDoRe V3 (48 tasks). On 1M and 5M records, a single-thread query takes 54.2 ms and 120.2 ms (11.1x and 25.3x faster than exact 4096-d single-vector search; 236x and 532x faster than full int8 MaxSim). Video is encoded directly from frames without a parsing model: on QVHighlights (1,083 queries), the peak falls inside the labeled segment for 78.0% of queries and the returned span (18% of video length) intersects it for 94.3% vs. 44.9% random. Weights and code: https://huggingface.co/tencent/OmniEVIE-4B and https://github.com/Tencent/OmniEVIE.
analysis: OmniEVIE 把每条记录压到 9,472 字节，MMEB-V3（190 个任务）得 60.06，只比不压缩的 d=2048 全序列低 0.62；百万库单线程查询 54.2 ms，比全量 int8 MaxSim 快 236 倍。它要回答的是：[[late-interaction|后期交互]]能保留局部证据，但索引太大、扫描太慢，能否压到接近单向量的成本直接上线。

做法是 ==ST-HAC==：用 Ward 层次聚类把一条记录的 token 向量合并成最多 128 个 64 维 int8 质心，位置编码只参与分组。同一条记录读出均值向量、1-bit 符号、int8 多向量，构成 ==三阶段检索==：全库粗筛留 5,000，XOR+popcount 中筛留 1,000，int8 MaxSim 定排序。训练时候选就按建索引的方式聚类；难负例按证据分三级，排除[[false-negative|假负例]]。

最值得记住的是训练时就压缩的效果：**全序列直接截到 d=64 只有 59.02，低于 128 个质心的发布索引 60.06**。ViDoRe V3 同预算下 ST-HAC 62.96，随机留 token 60.41，网格池化 56.50；4,096 字节里，64 个 64 维向量（62.47）胜过 32 个 128 维（61.82）。视频改成逐帧独立编码，正放/倒放判别从 75.63% 掉到 51.17%。
保留意见：**MMEB-V2 上它 77.96，低于同底座的单向量 WeMM-Emb-4B（79.19）**，收益主要在长文本和工具检索；400 token 的长 query 也要 439.9 ms。对做多模态 RAG 或 Agent 工具检索的团队，这是一套可照搬的配置：百万条 8.82 GiB，不用 reranker 重读原始媒体，命中还给出页面框或视频秒数，下游生成只读那一块。
star_reasons: 多向量检索压到百万条 8.82 GiB、单线程 54 ms
训练时按索引形态聚类，压缩后反超直接截维
命中可返回页面框和视频秒数，适合 RAG/Agent
权重与三阶段检索代码开源

papers.title: SOARS: System One Assisted Reranking for Agentic Search
papers.title_zh: 召回不变、只做重排：搜索 Agent 准确率从 73.9% 提到 84.7%
papers.summary_zh: 用免训练的快速相关性模型在每步搜索中重排，提升深度搜索Agent准确率并减少搜索次数。
papers.abstract_zh: 深度搜索Agent通过多轮迭代的检索与推理来满足复杂信息需求，检索到的证据是否相关会影响下游表现。现有reranker能提升检索效果，但在整个搜索轨迹中反复调用时会带来可观的延迟和成本。我们提出SOARS，一个==免训练==框架，利用[[system-one-model|System One模型]]做快速、经过校准的相关性估计。在每一步搜索中，SOARS从长文档中选出与query相关的段落，并在一次调用中对候选重排，同时考虑==原始问题和Agent生成的子query==。在BrowseComp-Plus和WebShaper上，跨六种LLM骨干，SOARS一致地提高了答案准确率和证据召回，同时减少搜索调用次数、端到端延迟和推理成本。在BrowseComp-Plus上，**GPT-5.4 Mini的准确率从73.9%提高到84.7%，搜索调用从23次降到14次**，显示了System One重排让深度搜索更有效、更高效的潜力。
papers.abstract_en: Deep search agents address complex information needs through iterative retrieval and reasoning, where the relevance of retrieved evidence influences downstream performance. Existing rerankers improve retrieval effectiveness but introduce substantial latency and cost when invoked throughout the search trajectory. We introduce SOARS, a training-free framework leveraging a System One model for fast, calibrated relevance estimation. At each search step, SOARS selects query-relevant passages from long documents and reranks candidates in a single call, jointly considering the original question and agent-generated sub-query. Across six LLM backbones on BrowseComp-Plus and WebShaper, SOARS consistently improves answer accuracy and evidence recall while reducing search calls, end-to-end latency, and inference cost. On BrowseComp-Plus, it improves GPT-5.4 Mini's accuracy from 73.9% to 84.7% while reducing search calls from 23 to 14, demonstrating the potential of System One reranking for more effective and efficient deep search.
analysis: 在深度搜索 Agent 的每次搜索后插一个重排器，能不能同时更准、更省？答案是能：在 BrowseComp-Plus 上，六个 LLM 骨干的准确率全部显著上升，相对涨幅从 GPT-5.5 的 10.2% 到 Gemini 2.5 Pro 的 63.8%，搜索次数也全部下降。前提是重排器够快，每次约 250 毫秒。

方法叫 SOARS，免训练。重排器是 [[system-one-model|System One 模型]] Jev：一次调用给 BM25 前 100 篇候选逐篇打分，输出 0–3 四档相关度的==校准概率分布==，按期望相关度排序。查询用==原问题 ⊕ 子 query==（用户原问题拼上 Agent 这一步写的子查询），文档只取标题加 128 token 的==重叠段落==（从子查询第一个非停用词在文中首次出现处截取，而不是取开头）。离线对比中 Recall@10 达 47.2%（gold），与 RankGPT 打平，延迟却是 254 毫秒对 8.7 秒。

最值得记住的是收益来源：**同一个 BM25 下，surfaced recall（搜索返回过的文档覆盖了多少答案文档）几乎没变**，变的是 [[preview-behavior-recall|previewed 和 behavior recall]]。GPT-5.5 的 previewed gold recall 从 72.9 升到 88.7，behavior 从 56.1 升到 79.0。答案文档本来就在候选里，只是排在 Agent 不看的位置。搜得少也省钱：Opus 4.7 总成本 $247→$119。
保留意见：**端到端实验只和“不重排”比，没把 RankGPT 等重排器同样放进循环**，“不输 LLM 重排”只在 50 题离线实验里成立；Jev 还是不开源的商用 API。对做搜索 Agent 的人：先看 previewed 与 surfaced recall 的差距，差距大时，在循环里加毫秒级重排并把原问题拼进 query，往往比换更强的召回或更大的 Agent 模型划算。
star_reasons: 六个骨干、两个基准全部同向提升
拆出收益来源：召回不变，靠把证据排到前面
同时报告准确率、延迟和美元成本
原问题拼进重排 query 的做法可直接搬用

papers.title: LARF: Learning-aligned Reasoning Framework for Search Relevance
papers.title_zh: 给打分 token 加一项 margin loss，比三种 RL 奖励加起来还管用
papers.affiliation: 腾讯元宝团队（Yuanbao Team, Tencent）
papers.summary_zh: 三阶段训练推理式相关性模型，并蒸馏为无需生成的分类头，延迟降低82.9%。
papers.abstract_zh: query-文档相关性估计是 AI 原生搜索系统的核心组件：模型需要在复杂、多维的标准下判断检索到的文档是否满足用户的信息需求。然而，直接把大语言模型用于该任务仍有困难：常规监督微调（SFT）对特定领域判断依据的监督有限，而标准的轨迹级强化学习（RL）目标并不显式拉开相邻有序相关性标签之间的间隔。此外，推理虽然在训练中有用，但 chain-of-thought（CoT）推理对延迟敏感的在线排序并不现实。这些问题使模糊的决策边界难以分清。我们提出三阶段框架 ==LARF==（Learning-Aligned Reasoning Framework for Search Relevance）：先在策略性挑选的样本上，用多 Agent 引导生成的 CoT 判断依据做冷启动 SFT；再采用==判别式 GRPO==（[[grpo]]），使用属性级、列表级和规则一致性奖励，并在终止相关性 token 上加 [[margin-loss|margin loss]]；最后把教师模型蒸馏为[[dual-head-distillation|双头学生模型]]，保留其分类头做非自回归推理。在一个人工标注的网页搜索相关性基准（约 30 万训练、1.6 万测试样本）上，**LARF-8B 的六分类准确率提高 5.78 个百分点，NDCG 提高 5.05 个点**，而**仅用分类头的服务路径使推理延迟降低 82.9%**。这些结果表明，把结构化推理、终止决策优化和分类头蒸馏对齐起来，可以为工业搜索相关性建模提供有效的精度-效率权衡。
papers.abstract_en: Query-document relevance estimation is a core component of AI-native search systems, where a model must assess whether retrieved documents satisfy users' information needs under complex, multi-dimensional criteria. However, directly applying large language models (LLMs) to this task remains challenging because conventional supervised fine-tuning (SFT) provides limited supervision for domain-specific judgment rationales, while standard trajectory-level reinforcement learning (RL) objectives do not explicitly enforce margin separation among adjacent ordinal relevance labels. Moreover, although such reasoning can be useful during training, chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning is impractical for latency-sensitive online ranking. These challenges make it difficult to resolve ambiguous decision boundaries. We propose a three-stage framework LARF (Learning-Aligned Reasoning Framework for Search Relevance): it first performs cold-start SFT on strategically selected samples with multi-agent guided CoT rationales, then applies discriminative GRPO with attribute-wise, list-wise, and rule-consistency rewards together with a margin loss on the terminal relevance token, and finally distills the teacher into a dual-head student whose classification heads are retained for non-autoregressive inference. On a human-annotated web search relevance benchmark with approximately 300K training and 16K test instances, LARF-8B improves six-class classification accuracy by 5.78 percentage points and NDCG by 5.05 points, while the classification-only serving path reduces inference latency by 82.9\%. These results indicate that aligning structured reasoning, terminal decision optimization, and classification-head distillation can provide an effective accuracy--efficiency trade-off for industrial search relevance modeling.
analysis: 这篇论文来自腾讯元宝 AI 搜索团队，追问的是：用 LLM 给 query-文档打 0–5 六档相关分，难点到底在哪？他们的答案是相邻档位之间的边界。8B 模型的六分类准确率从 45.20% 提到 50.98%（+5.78），NDCG 从 74.51 到 79.56，其中最大的单笔增益来自直接约束最终打分 token 的一项损失。

做法分三段。==冷启动 SFT==：按主题分层、按相关档位覆盖、再加难例挑出 1/3 的数据，由语义、时效、权威、质量四个 Agent 分别写分析，协调者在人工标签的条件下汇总成 CoT 目标。==判别式 GRPO==：[[grpo]] 的奖励由属性级、列表级（同一 query 下文档排序的一致率）和规则一致性三项相加，另外在输出档位数字的那个位置，对 0–5 六个数字的 logits 加 hinge 式 [[margin-loss|margin loss]]。==双头蒸馏==：[[dual-head-distillation|共享骨干接 5 个分类头和 1 个生成头]]，上线时只走分类头。

最值得记住的是消融表 3：三种奖励合起来只把准确率从 46.12% 推到 47.40%，其中规则奖励只贡献 0.22 点，还让二分类精度从 71.95 降到 71.28；**margin loss 一项就从 47.40% 拉到 49.35%**。表 4 也有意思：只训分类头得到 48.95%，比带 CoT 的自回归推理（49.35%）低；训练时加回生成头作正则，单头升到 50.65%，五个维度头到 50.98%。理由监督在训练时有用，推理时可以不生成。

保留意见：**82.9% 的延迟下降是 8B 双头模型相对 8B 自回归（5.68 秒降到 0.97 秒/对）**，线上 A/B 部署的却是 1.7B 学生，它的离线准确率只有 45.80%，比没有经过 LARF 训练的 Qwen3-8B 只高 0.6 点，论文也没给它的延迟；另外 Qwen3-Reranker 基线是否在同一批 30 万数据上微调过没有说明，所有离线结果都来自内部测试集。对做 LLM 相关性打分的团队来说，如果模型最终输出一个档位 token，在 GRPO 里给这个 token 加 margin loss 是改动最小、收益最大的一步；CoT 可以只留在训练阶段。
star_reasons: 消融把增益拆到每个组件，margin loss 单项最大
训练用 CoT、推理只走分类头的工业落地路径
有元宝 AI 搜索线上 A/B 结果

papers.title: Bathys: Advancing Deep Search Agents
papers.title_zh: 按压缩边界切段做 RL，27B 搜索 Agent 多涨 9 个点

papers.summary_zh: 发布9B和27B深度搜索智能体，用SFT、KTO与CM-GSPO训练，BrowseComp达80.49%
papers.abstract_zh: 深度搜索是智能体处理复杂开放式任务的关键能力：这类任务需要迭代地收集信息、改写 query 并基于证据做验证，而不是一次检索就能解决。为此我们提出 Bathys 9B 和 27B 深度搜索智能体，其训练框架涵盖可验证问题合成、后训练，以及在[[context-compaction|上下文压缩]]下的在线强化学习（RL）。我们的高质量数据构造同时保证搜索深度与可靠性：每条线索都被改写为需要单独检索才能解开的==间接指代==，保留下来的证据链则可用于验证这些线索共同确定唯一答案。精选轨迹支撑起由监督微调（SFT）、Kahneman–Tversky 优化（[[kto|KTO]]）和==压缩管理的组序列策略优化（CM-GSPO）==组成的训练流程：SFT 为长程工具使用和 query 改写打下稳定基础；KTO 利用轨迹级的二元反馈，改进对有证据支撑的答案的选择；CM-GSPO 在记录下来的 rollout 上下文上，用长度归一化的似然比优化执行子轨迹，并对子轨迹优势重新加权，以修正对各子轨迹损失分别取平均所带来的额外权重。在带有轨迹自验证和条件重试的评测协议下，Bathys 9B 和 27B 在 BrowseComp 上分别达到 **66.51% 和 80.49%**。
papers.abstract_en: Deep search is a critical capability for agents tackling complex, open-ended tasks, where solving a problem requires iterative information gathering, query reformulation, and evidence-based verification rather than a single retrieval step. To address these requirements, we present Bathys 9B and 27B deep search agents built around a training framework that spans verifiable question synthesis, post-training, and online reinforcement learning (RL) under context compression. Our high-quality data construction ensures both search depth and reliability: each clue is reformulated as an indirect reference requiring independent retrieval, and retained evidence chains enable verification that the clues jointly determine a unique answer. Curated trajectories underpin a pipeline of supervised fine-tuning (SFT), Kahneman-Tversky Optimization (KTO), and Compaction-Managed Group Sequence Policy Optimization (CM-GSPO): SFT provides a stable foundation for tool use over long horizons and query reformulation; KTO uses binary feedback on trajectories to improve the selection of answers grounded in evidence; CM-GSPO optimizes execution sub-trajectories with length-normalized likelihood ratios on the recorded rollout contexts and reweights sub-trajectory advantages to correct the extra weighting introduced by independently averaging sub-trajectory losses. Bathys 9B and 27B attain 66.51% and 80.49% on BrowseComp, respectively, under an evaluation protocol with trajectory self-verification and conditional retries.
analysis: 27B 模型从 KTO 检查点出发做在线 RL，用 ==CM-GSPO== 后在 200 题 BrowseComp 子集上从 66.50% 涨到 75.50%（+9.00，未开自验证）；同起点的普通 [[gspo|GSPO]] 和把[[context-compaction|上下文压缩]]直接塞进 GSPO 的 Compaction RL，**在四个基准上都没超过 KTO**。论文追问：轨迹长到要压缩历史时，RL 梯度该怎么算。
做法是按每次压缩把 rollout 切成 ==子轨迹==，每段在其起点保存的上下文下算长度归一化的重要性比；各段共享整条轨迹的优势值，再乘以该段 token 占比，避免切得碎的轨迹被放大。流程为 SFT → [[kto|KTO]] → CM-GSPO，基座 Qwen3.5-9B / Qwen3.6-27B，数据合成和 CM-GSPO 沿用同团队的 Glasseek。
KTO 让 27B 超时率从 15.5% 升到 26.0%，准确率却从 65.00% 升到 66.50%；同一数据池换成成对的 DPO，9B 掉 4.00 点、27B 掉 1.50 点。**9B 上 CM-GSPO 完成率到 99.5%，平均轮数却从 61.5 涨到 98.5。**
保留意见：主表 66.51% / 80.49% 用了 ==自验证加条件重试==，**论文没给全量集去掉自验证的分数和重试次数**，无法和训练收益分开。对做长程搜索 Agent 的团队：rollout 中途会压缩历史，就不能把它当普通序列交给 GSPO，否则 RL 可能白跑甚至倒退。
star_reasons: 压缩感知 RL 有对照消融：普通 GSPO 反而退步
KTO 与 DPO 同数据池对比，DPO 两个规模都掉点
9B 开源模型 BrowseComp 66.51%，权重与部分数据开源

papers.title: Speculative Decoding for Semantic-ID-Based Generative Recommendations
papers.title_zh: 面向语义ID生成式推荐的投机解码
papers.summary_zh: SIDECAR用草稿加树注意力验证并给出精确top-K证书，减少SID生成式召回的模型调用。
papers.abstract_zh: 基于语义ID（SID）的生成式推荐系统把每个item表示为长度为$L$的离散token短序列，并用序列模型根据用户历史预测下一个item的token。工业级部署通常用这类模型配合带约束的beam search为每个请求检索多个候选。然而这带来每个请求固定$L$次顺序模型调用的开销，并且当SID生成器变得不那么尖锐时精度会下降，而输出与精确top-$K$有多接近并无保证。因此生产系统无法发现单个请求上检索质量的退化。我们提出SIDECAR，用近似的草稿候选加一次树注意力计算，在内存允许时一次模型调用就对整个草稿打分。这次计算给出每个未探索SID前缀概率的上界，如果草稿包含精确top-$K$，就==证明其为精确结果==。否则，分支定界回退只展开trie中仍可能改变输出的部分，对任意草稿最多$L$次调用即可完成证明。此外，在每次调用$M$个token、共$Y$次调用的预算下（$Y = L$时与宽度为$M$的beam search资源相当），SIDECAR会==公布一个因子$1 + δ$==，保证其列表在每个排名上都在该因子内是精确的。根据模型的尖锐程度，**SIDECAR只需beam search的一小部分调用或内存就能返回精确top-$K$**。即使预算太小、无法恢复精确top-$K$，SIDECAR也不同于beam search，会报告公布的因子，使服务系统在达到质量目标或延迟上限时可以提前停止。
papers.abstract_en: Generative recommender systems with Semantic IDs (SIDs) represent each item as a short sequence of $L$ discrete tokens and use a sequence model to predict the next item's tokens from a user's history. Industry-scale deployments typically use these models to retrieve multiple candidates per request with constrained beam search. However, this incurs a fixed cost of $L$ sequential model calls per request, and accuracy degrades as the SID generator becomes less sharp, without a guarantee on how close the output is to the exact top-$K$. Production systems therefore cannot detect degraded retrieval for individual requests. We propose SIDECAR, which uses approximate draft candidates and a tree-attention pass to score the entire draft in a single model call, memory permitting. This pass bounds the probability of every unexplored SID prefix and certifies the exact top-$K$ if the draft contains them. Otherwise, a branch-and-bound fallback expands only the parts of the trie that can still change the output, reaching certification within at most $L$ calls for any draft. Moreover, under a budget of $M$ tokens per call and $Y$ calls, which for $Y = L$ matches the resources of a beam search of width $M$, SIDECAR announces a factor $1 + δ$ within which its list will be exact at every rank. Depending on model sharpness, SIDECAR returns the exact top-$K$ using a fraction of beam search's calls or memory. Even when the budget is too small to recover the exact top-$K$, SIDECAR, unlike beam search, reports the announced factor, allowing the serving system to stop early once a quality target or latency limit is reached.

papers.title: KuroANN: Avoiding Unnecessary SSD Reads in High-Recall Filtered Vector Search
papers.title_zh: KuroANN：在高召回过滤向量搜索中避免不必要的SSD读取
papers.summary_zh: 按每个query的过滤匹配数分配SSD读取量，减少磁盘过滤向量搜索的无效I/O。
papers.abstract_zh: 我们提出KuroANN，一个面向分区索引的新型SSD上过滤向量搜索系统。现有方案对同一选择率区间内的所有query分配相同数量的SSD读取，对许多query造成I/O浪费。KuroANN则根据每个query通过过滤的向量数量（即==匹配数==）来分配其SSD读取。这基于我们的观察：匹配数在搜索前就已知，而query所需的SSD读取次数取决于匹配数。KuroANN离线测量在每个匹配数下达到目标召回需要探测多少分区、读取多少候选。运行时，query查表得到这些数值，只对被探测的分区做过滤，并在继续读取SSD不太可能有帮助时停止。这大幅避免了不必要的SSD读取和过滤工作，在高召回下提升吞吐并降低延迟。实验结果表明，KuroANN**最高比PipeANN-Filter快34.5倍、比Faiss快9.10倍**。
papers.abstract_en: We present KuroANN, a new on-SSD filtered vector search system for partition indexes. Existing solutions assign the same number of SSD reads to all queries within a given selectivity range, wasting I/O for many queries. KuroANN instead assigns each query's SSD reads based on the number of vectors that pass its filter, called its match count. This is based on our observation that the match count is known before the search and that the number of SSD reads a query requires depends on this match count. KuroANN measures offline how many partitions to probe and candidates to read for the target recall at each count. At runtime, a query looks up these numbers, filters only the probed partitions, and stops reading from the SSD when further reads are unlikely to help. This significantly avoids unnecessary SSD reads and filtering work, improving throughput and latency at high recall. Experimental results show that KuroANN outperforms PipeANN-Filter and Faiss by up to 34.5x and 9.10x, respectively.

papers.title: LazUnirec: Unifying Retrieval and Ranking in Multi-scenario Industrial Recommendation
papers.title_zh: LazUnirec：多场景工业推荐中统一召回与排序
papers.summary_zh: 在共享Transformer中用LoRA调制注意力和稀疏MoE统一召回与排序，已上线
papers.abstract_zh: 现代工业推荐系统通常把召回和排序拆成两个级联阶段，导致优化目标不一致、用户序列重复编码和计算资源浪费。已有工作尝试用Transformer同时建模召回与排序，但仍有两个主要局限：（1）召回与排序共享同一个Transformer骨干，两个任务的梯度方向不一致时会产生梯度冲突；（2）发生梯度冲突时，模型无法确定可靠的梯度更新方向。为此我们提出面向多场景工业推荐的统一召回与排序方法LazUnirec。具体而言，我们在Transformer骨干上构造任务共享与任务私有参数以缓解梯度冲突。其中，对注意力部分，我们提出==LoRA调制注意力==，使召回与排序共享注意力参数的同时保留任务私有参数；对前馈网络（FFN），我们提出==任务自适应稀疏混合专家（MoE）==，通过构造任务共享与任务私有专家来缓解梯度冲突。此外，我们提出不确定性估计来评估召回与排序梯度的可靠性，在发生梯度冲突时引导模型走向更可靠的更新方向。同时，从排序到召回的知识蒸馏进一步实现跨任务知识迁移。大量离线实验和在线A/B测试验证了LazUnirec的有效性和优越性。**LazUnirec已部署于线上多场景工业推荐系统，并为平台带来显著收益。**
papers.abstract_en: Modern industrial recommendation systems typically divide retrieval and ranking into two separate cascaded stages, leading to inconsistent optimization objectives, redundant encoding of user sequences, and a waste of computational resources. Previous efforts have investigated using Transformers to model both retrieval and ranking simultaneously. However, these studies still face two major limitations: (1) Since retrieval and ranking share a single Transformer backbone, the gradient conflict arises when the gradient directions of the two tasks are inconsistent. (2) When gradient conflict occurs, the model cannot determine a reliable direction for gradient updates. To this end, we propose a Unified Retrieval and Ranking approach for Multi-scenario Industrial Recommendation, termed as LazUnirec. Specifically, we construct task-shared and task-private parameters on the Transformer backbone to mitigate the gradient conflict. Wherein, for the attention components, we propose LoRA-modulated attention, enabling retrieval and ranking to share attention parameters while preserving task-private parameters. For the feed-forward networks (FFN), we present task-adaptive sparse mixture-of-experts (MoE) to mitigate gradient conflict by constructing task-shared and task-private experts. Moreover, we propose an uncertainty estimation that evaluates the gradient reliability of the retrieval and ranking, thereby guiding the model toward a more reliable gradient update direction when gradient conflict occurs. In addition, knowledge distillation from ranking to retrieval further enables cross-task knowledge transfer. Extensive offline experiments and online A/B testing demonstrate the effectiveness and superiority of LazUnirec. LazUnirec has been deployed in online multi-scenario industrial recommendation system and currently delivers significant gains for the platform.

papers.title: See the Answer, Learn to Embed: Learning Universal Multimodal Embeddings from Hindsight
papers.title_zh: 看见答案，学会嵌入：从后见之明中学习通用多模态Embedding
papers.summary_zh: 用候选条件的后见教师蒸馏出无需候选的多模态embedding学生模型。
papers.abstract_zh: 通用多模态嵌入（UME）模型把异构的多模态输入映射到共享嵌入空间，用成对相似度支持各类下游任务。近期由推理驱动的 UME 方法借助中间推理生成额外上下文来辅助嵌入，但推理时往往带来额外计算。本文探索把匹配的候选（即配对目标）作为另一种上下文来源：模型能否在训练时“看到答案”，而在推理时无需答案也能“学会嵌入”。然而，直接以这种特权上下文作为条件，可能引入仅凭 query 无法获得的候选特有信息，也可能使候选条件下的 query 表示坍缩到候选嵌入上。为此我们提出 ==Hindsight-Enhanced Multimodal Embeddings（HEME）==，从候选上下文中学习以 query 为根基的==后见表示==。HEME 先用后见注意力掩码、失配候选条件和 query-token 对齐训练一个后见教师，以限制其对候选的过度依赖；随后冻结教师，把它的后见表示和相似度分布蒸馏到一个独立的学生嵌入器中。推理时，学生独立编码 query 和候选，不需要候选条件，也不需要后见教师。在 MMEB-V2 以及 MMEB-V3 的 agent 与文本任务上的实验证明了 HEME 的有效性，且**推理效率高于显式推理驱动的方法**。
papers.abstract_en: Universal Multimodal Embedding (UME) models map heterogeneous multimodal inputs into a shared embedding space, where pairwise similarity supports diverse downstream tasks. Recent reasoning-driven UME approaches use intermediate reasoning to generate additional context for embedding, but often incur extra computation at inference. In this paper, we explore the matched candidate (i.e., the paired target) as an alternative source of context, asking whether a model can "see the answer" during training and "learn to embed" without it at inference. However, direct conditioning on this privileged context can introduce candidate-specific information unavailable from the query alone or cause the candidate-conditioned query representation to collapse toward the candidate embedding. To address this, we introduce Hindsight-Enhanced Multimodal Embeddings (HEME), which learns query-grounded hindsight representations from such candidate context. HEME first trains a hindsight teacher with a hindsight attention mask, mismatched-candidate conditioning, and query-token alignment to limit excessive reliance on the candidate. It then freezes the teacher and distills its hindsight representation and similarity distribution into a standalone student embedder. At inference, the student independently encodes queries and candidates without candidate conditioning or the hindsight teacher. Experiments on MMEB-V2 and the agent and text tasks of MMEB-V3 demonstrate the effectiveness of HEME and show that it enables more efficient inference than explicit reasoning-driven methods.

papers.title: User-Adaptive Fusion of Multiple Foundation Models for Recommender Systems
papers.title_zh: 面向推荐系统的多基础模型用户自适应融合
papers.summary_zh: 按用户自适应地在得分层融合多个基础模型的推荐视图，UF2O最多领先7%。
papers.abstract_zh: 推荐系统能否从组合多种模态内及跨模态的基础模型中获益？不同基础模型可能捕捉物品元数据的互补方面，但我们发现，直接组合它们的表示相比只用单个基础模型，仅有微弱提升。我们的关键观察是：==从不同基础模型中受益的用户各不相同==。基于此，我们提出UF2O，一种面向推荐的用户自适应多基础模型融合方法。简言之，UF2O为每个基础模型维护独立的推荐视图，将各模型的贡献建模为用户特定的，并按用户自适应地组合它们的得分。由于在==得分层面==融合，UF2O无需直接对齐表示空间，即可融合异构的基础模型。在四个数据集上联合组合四个基础模型的大量实验表明，UF2O在静态和序列推荐设置下均优于现有融合方法，**相对最强融合基线最多提升7%**。我们工作的代码、数据集和补充材料见 https://github.com/kswoo97/UFFO。
papers.abstract_en: Can recommender systems benefit from combining a collection of foundation models within and across modalities? While different foundation models may capture complementary aspects of item metadata, we find that naively combining their representations yields only marginal gains over using a single foundation model. We make a key observation: the users who benefit vary across foundation models. Motivated by this observation, we introduce UF2O, a user-adaptive approach for fusing multiple foundation models for recommendation. In a nutshell, UF2O models the contribution of each foundation model as user-specific by maintaining separate recommendation views and adaptively combining their scores for each user. By performing fusion at the score level, UF2O can also fuse heterogeneous foundation models without directly aligning their representation spaces. Extensive experiments that jointly combine four foundation models on four datasets show that UF2O outperforms existing fusion approaches in both static and sequential recommendation settings, with improvements of up to 7% over the strongest fusion baseline. The code, datasets, and supplementary materials for our work are available at https://github.com/kswoo97/UFFO.

papers.title: MELODI: Similarity-Identity Decoupling for Lightweight Ranking
papers.title_zh: MELODI：面向轻量排序的相似性-身份解耦
papers.summary_zh: 把目标-历史相似性与目标自身信息解耦，做低延迟候选排序，并在工业数据上验证。
papers.abstract_zh: 针对延迟受限的候选排序，我们提出==相似性-身份解耦框架==，将目标与历史的匹配度同目标自身的信息分开。我们研究了计算池化相似度的两种顺序，即先相似后池化与先池化后相似，并指出对每个固定目标而言，相似度算子关于历史参数的线性性是两者等价的充分条件，从而说明了更廉价的先池化后相似形式是合理的。我们将该框架实例化为MELODI（多头高效轻量的身份-相似度解耦算子），其相似度分支结合目标条件的多头历史池化与一个对池化历史输入呈线性的无残差单层交叉层，身份分支则随具体问题而定。在公开基准数据集上，MELODI达到或超过所评估的目标感知和目标无关基线。在两个大规模工业数据集上，其AUPRC、NDCG和召回率均不低于所评估的目标感知基线。处理器实测显示，在候选数量较大时，其延迟低于所评估的候选条件基线，利用请求内历史复用后延迟进一步降低。
papers.abstract_en: For latency-constrained candidate ranking, we propose a similarity-identity decoupling framework that separates target-history compatibility from target-only information. We study two orders for computing pooled similarity, similarity-then-pool and pool-then-similarity, and identify linearity of the similarity operator in its history argument, for each fixed target, as sufficient for their equivalence, justifying the cheaper pool-then-similarity form. We instantiate the framework as multi-head efficient lightweight operator for decoupling identity and similarity (MELODI), whose similarity branch combines target-conditioned multi-head history pooling with a single residual-free cross layer that is linear in its pooled-history input and whose identity branch is problem-dependent. On public benchmark datasets, MELODI matches or surpasses the evaluated target-aware and target-agnostic baselines. On two large-scale industrial datasets, its area under the precision-recall curve (AUPRC), normalised discounted cumulative gain (NDCG), and recall values are equal to or higher than those of the evaluated target-aware baselines. Processor measurements show lower latency than the evaluated candidate-conditioned baselines at large candidate counts, further reduced by request-local history reuse.

papers.title: SPARQL-Planned Single-Hop Traversal over a Live Knowledge Graph for Multi-Hop Question Answering
papers.title_zh: 基于SPARQL规划的实时知识图谱单跳遍历，用于多跳问答
papers.summary_zh: 让稠密检索与Wikidata图遍历交替进行，由LLM生成SPARQL规划但只解析不执行
papers.abstract_zh: 语义检索在多跳问答上的召回和精度都不理想：gold段落淹没在干扰段落中，会拉低reader的回答质量，而且要找到它们需要对query做推理，而不是简单匹配。GraphRAG技术通过把段落连接到图节点，并在初始检索之后做一跳或多跳扩展来增强语义检索。这能提高召回，但多跳扩展代价高昂，还会给检索结果带来额外噪声。我们对复杂多跳问题采用将稠密检索与知识图谱遍历==交错进行==的方式来打破这一权衡：稠密检索以较好的召回率定位搜索空间中最先相关的区域，而对已有外部KG（Wikidata）的遍历则通过沿KG中的推理路径确认检索到的段落，恢复精度并进一步提高召回。为使遍历既能适应问题又可靠，我们让LLM把遍历规划为生成SPARQL格式图遍历代码的任务，但==只解析而不执行==该查询。在共享语料和reader、且所有数据集使用同一配置的完整1,000题划分上，我们在HotpotQA上达到**62.5 / 75.1** EM/F1，在2WikiMultiHopQA上达到73.5 / 81.0，在MuSiQue上达到37.1 / 50.0，三个基准均领先于复现的HippoRAG2、T²RAG和IRCoT。在第二种token对齐的设置下，花费大致相当于T²RAG的单query预算，在HotpotQA和2Wiki上仍然领先。如果执行生成的SPARQL而不是解析它，EM最多损失11.4，主要原因是原始查询返回空结果，而不是语法错误。
papers.abstract_en: Semantic retrieval struggles with multi-hop question answering on both recall and precision: gold passages are buried among distractors that degrade the reader's answer, and retrieving them requires reasoning over the query rather than matching it. GraphRAG techniques expand semantic retrieval by connecting passages to graph nodes and performing one or more hops of expansion after initial retrieval. This improves recall, but multi-hop expansion becomes expensive and brings additional noise into the retrieved set. We break this tradeoff by \emph{interleaving} dense retrieval with knowledge-graph traversal for complex multi-hop questions. Dense retrieval locates the first relevant regions of the search space at good recall, while traversal of a pre-existing external KG (Wikidata) restores precision and improves recall by confirming retrieved passages against a reasoning path through the KG. To keep traversal both question-adaptive and reliable, we have an LLM plan it as code generation task for graph traversal in SPARQL format but \emph{parse rather than execute} the query. On full 1{,}000-question splits under a shared corpus and reader, and with a single configuration applied identically to every dataset, we reach \textbf{62.5 / 75.1} EM/F1 on HotpotQA, \textbf{73.5 / 81.0} on 2WikiMultiHopQA, and \textbf{37.1 / 50.0} on MuSiQue, ahead of reproduced HippoRAG2, T\textsuperscript{2}RAG, and IRCoT on all three benchmarks. A second, token-matched setting stays ahead of T\textsuperscript{2}RAG on HotpotQA and 2Wiki while spending roughly its per-query budget. Executing the generated SPARQL instead of parsing it costs up to 11.4 EM, mostly because raw queries return empty results, not because of syntax errors.

papers.title: Teaching Time Without Losing General Retrieval: Adapting Multimodal Embeddings for Time-Sensitive Video Retrieval
papers.title_zh: 教会时间而不丢失通用检索:面向时间敏感视频检索的多模态 embedding 适配
papers.summary_zh: 用 keep loss、pair loss 和中间层 LoRA 让单个模型同时兼顾通用与时间敏感视频检索。
papers.abstract_zh: 在文本到视频检索中,基于 MLLM 的 embedding 模型在文本描述场景(通用检索)时表现良好,但在描述动作及其方向(时间敏感检索)时表现较差。先驱工作 TARA 在带有时间困难负例的文本三元组上微调这类模型,提升了时间敏感检索,却降低了通用检索(在 Qwen3-VL-Embedding-8B 上重跑,六个基准的平均 R@1:58.4->44.8),并且其发布的模型只有与 Qwen3-VL-Embedding 集成时才能保持通用检索。我们的目标是用一个模型、每个片段一个向量,同时获得强的通用检索和时间敏感检索。三点发现带来了三个简单组件。==Keep loss==:通用检索取决于输出 embedding 偏离基础模型的程度,而不是权重移动的距离;因此我们让它们保持在基础模型附近,即使没有通用领域数据也能保留大部分通用检索能力。==Pair loss==:动作描述及其反向版本的文本 embedding 分得很开,但一个片段及其倒放副本的视频 embedding 却很接近;因此我们沿两者文本 embedding 之差的方向,拉大每个片段与其倒放副本的视频 embedding 之间的距离。==中间层 LoRA==:帧在中间层被组合,时间信息在这些层或其后达到峰值;因此我们只在这些层训练 LoRA,在多数时间敏感基准上几乎与训练全部权重持平,仅用 0.15% 的参数,并且更好地保持了通用检索。通用 R@1 保持在 58.4,而图库中含每个片段倒放副本时的 R@1 **从 55.5 升到 63.2**;收益可迁移到未见过的基准以及 InternVL2-8B-RA。Keep loss 也可用于补救 TARA 的方案(通用 R@1:44.8->57.8),并且将 TARA 与我们的方法集成,在 RTime 和未见过的 CiA 上取得了所比较模型中的最高分。
papers.abstract_en: In text-to-video retrieval, MLLM-based embedding models do well when the text describes the scene (general retrieval), but poorly when it describes actions and their direction (time-sensitive retrieval). TARA, a pioneering work, fine-tunes such a model on text triplets with temporal hard negatives; it improves time-sensitive retrieval but lowers general retrieval (mean R@1 over six benchmarks in our rerun on Qwen3-VL-Embedding-8B: 58.4->44.8), and its released model keeps general retrieval only when ensembled with Qwen3-VL-Embedding. Our goal is strong general and time-sensitive retrieval with one model and one vector per clip. Three findings lead to three simple components. Keep loss: general retrieval follows how far the output embeddings drift from the base model, not how far the weights move; we therefore keep them near the base model, which keeps most general retrieval even without general-domain data. Pair loss: the text embeddings of an action description and its reversed-direction version are well separated, but the video embeddings of a clip and its reversed copy are close; we therefore widen the gap between the video embeddings of each clip and its reversed copy, in the direction of the difference between their two text embeddings. Middle-layer LoRA: frames are combined in the middle layers, and temporal information peaks in or just after them; we therefore train LoRA only on these layers, which nearly matches training all weights on most time-sensitive benchmarks with 0.15% of the parameters and keeps general retrieval better. General R@1 stays at 58.4, while R@1 with each clip's reversed copy in the gallery rises from 55.5 to 63.2; the gains carry over to unseen benchmarks and InternVL2-8B-RA. The keep loss is also a remedy for the TARA recipe (general R@1: 44.8->57.8), and ensembling TARA with Ours gives the highest scores on RTime and unseen CiA among the compared models.

papers.title: Learning the Platform, Not the Learner: Sequencing Shortcuts in the Offline Evaluation of Educational Recommender Systems and LLM Rankers
papers.title_zh: 学到的是平台而非学习者：教育推荐系统与LLM排序器离线评估中的序列捷径
papers.summary_zh: 教育推荐离线评测主要反映平台的活动安排结构，仅用上一活动的结构预测器就接近最优
papers.abstract_zh: 教育推荐系统通常在辅导系统、学习应用和MOOC的日志上，按预测下一个活动的准确度进行离线比较，而下一个活动在很大程度上是由平台决定的：教师布置习题集、辅导系统不断出题直到掌握、引擎选择题目。我们在来自五个平台的八个公开数据集上，比较了四种结构预测器（除上一个活动外不使用任何学习者信息）、十种个性化推荐器，以及0.5到70亿参数的开源LLM排序器，并采用两种评测协议。**结构预测器达到任一方法最佳准确度的0.81到1.00（中位数0.95）**，主要靠的是总体转移统计而非课程顺序；最佳个性化推荐器在五个数据集上显著更好，NDCG@10高出0.007到0.102，在Eedi上四次训练中有三次更好。所有方法在训练中从未见过的转移步骤，以及由学习者自己选择的步骤上，准确度都低得多。LLM排序器在随机负样本下看似胜任，但从未明显优于词匹配基线；在符合课程结构的合理负样本下，无论模型大小，它们都接近随机，或远逊于转移启发式方法。在已知学习者需求的模拟中，结构部分的占比与平台决定步骤的占比一致，且离线准确度会把学习者需求的oracle排在平台模仿者之后。按结构下步骤的出现可能性给测试步骤加权，可以在很大程度上恢复准确度与有用性的联系，并在真实数据上的八个数据集中有七个发现了显著的个性化信号。我们提出一份考虑教学大纲的评估清单，并发布一个Python包，用于报告任意推荐器相对于结构基线的提升。
papers.abstract_en: Educational recommenders are usually compared offline, by how well they predict the next activity in logs of tutoring systems, learning applications and MOOCs, where the next activity is largely decided by the platform: teachers assign problem sets, tutors draw problems until mastery, engines select questions. On eight public datasets from five platforms, we compare four structural predictors, which use nothing about the learner beyond the last activity, with ten personalised recommenders and with open-weight LLM rankers from 0.5 to 7 billion parameters, under two protocols. The structural predictors reach between 0.81 and 1.00 of the best accuracy of any method (median 0.95), mostly through population transitions rather than the course order; the best personalised recommender is significantly better on five datasets, by 0.007 to 0.102 NDCG@10, and on Eedi in three of four training runs. Every method is far less accurate on steps along transitions never seen in training and on steps chosen by learners. LLM rankers look competent with random negatives but are never much better than a word-matching baseline, and with negatives that are plausible under the course structure they stay close to random or well behind the transition heuristic, whatever their size. In a simulation with known learner needs, the structural share tracks the share of steps decided by the platform, and offline accuracy ranks an oracle of the learners' needs below imitators of the platform. Weighting test steps by how unlikely the structure makes them restores much of the link with usefulness and, on the real data, reveals a significant personalisation signal on seven of the eight datasets. We propose a syllabus-aware evaluation checklist and release a Python package that reports the lift of any recommender over the structure.

papers.title: RELAY: Learning Compatible Representations One Encoder at a Time
papers.title_zh: RELAY：一次一个编码器地学习兼容表示
papers.summary_zh: 先训新query编码器对齐旧库，再训新文档编码器，实现向量库增量重编码时的兼容检索。
papers.abstract_zh: 在图库增量重编码期间，新旧文档embedding会同时存在。==RELAY==先针对原始图库，用学到的投影训练新的query编码器，再冻结两者来训练新的文档编码器。同一个query向量在整个单次重编码过程中可以为新旧两种版本的文档打分。回填完成后，可选的query精炼会去掉投影，并复用已存储的文档向量。在COCO和Flickr30K上的三种文本到图像检索升级中，RELAY在未改动的图库上将Recall@1相对原系统**提升8.66-10.23个百分点**。对于直接重编码，在原生打分和匹配校准两种条件下，RELAY在两个Qwen到Qwen的升级中按Recall@1曲线下面积均排第一，在CLIP到Qwen中排第二。在embedding固定时，为每个文档版本单独校准分数可以减少回填期间Recall@1的下降，并改变哪种方法的回填AUC最高。经过query精炼后，三种升级的最终Recall@1与常规联合训练的差距都在0.97个百分点以内。
papers.abstract_en: Old and new document embeddings coexist during incremental gallery re-encoding. RELAY trains a new query encoder with a learned projection against the original gallery, then freezes both to train the new document encoder. The same query vector scores both document versions throughout a single re-encoding pass. After backfill, optional query refinement drops the projection and reuses the stored document vectors. Across three text-to-image retrieval upgrades on COCO and Flickr30K, RELAY improves Recall@1 on untouched galleries by 8.66-10.23 percentage points over the original systems. For direct re-encoding, RELAY ranks first in both Qwen-to-Qwen upgrades and second in CLIP-to-Qwen by area under the Recall@1 curve, under both native scoring and matched calibration. With embeddings held fixed, calibrating scores separately for each document version can reduce drops in Recall@1 during backfill and change which method achieves the highest backfill AUC. After query refinement, final Recall@1 is within 0.97 percentage points of conventional joint training in all three upgrades.

papers.title: BRAG: Bayesian Retrieval Augmented Generation
papers.title_zh: BRAG：贝叶斯检索增强生成
papers.summary_zh: 用贝叶斯生成模型统一RAG中的反馈式检索改进方法，并在记忆检索上提升Recall
papers.abstract_zh: 检索增强生成（RAG）按与query的语义相似度对记忆chunk排序。许多方法通过学习对已检索内容的反馈来改进，但每种都是独立的启发式，无法说明何时适用。我们提出BRAG，一个“检索与使用”的==生成模型==。每个chunk从以其原始embedding为锚点的von Mises-Fisher混合分量中生成它所能回答的query，且每个chunk带有随时间漂移的潜在效用。该模型给出最优推断：一个闭式滤波器，每个chunk只需存储少量key和两个标量，并根据curator的标签在线更新，同时把检索表述为一个控制问题。它还说明了现有方法何时最优：query平均、Rocchio式反馈和频率重排序是固定参数下的特例，NUDGE是每个chunk一个key且无动态的情形，LADER则是每个历史query一个key的极限。在两个公开的长期记忆基准上，BRAG在已问过的query上与这些方法持平，这符合预期，因为当没有随时间变化时，这些特例的假设成立。在更难的问题上，即新chunk使旧chunk过时时，BRAG胜出：它们都停留在普通检索水平（Recall@5为0.67-0.71），而BRAG能以**0.80-0.86**的概率检索到新chunk。我们还在NUDGE的七个文本基准中的三个上运行了BRAG，它在三个上都持平或超过NUDGE。在一个个人智能体九个月的记忆（20,640个chunk）上，BRAG把留出query的Recall@5从0.75提高到0.98，Recall@1从0.44提高到**0.97**，而对从未被查询的chunk影响很小。
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) ranks memory chunks by semantic similarity to the query. Many methods improve on this by learning from feedback on what was retrieved, but each is a separate heuristic, with no account of when it is the right choice. We introduce BRAG, a generative model of retrieval with use. Each chunk generates the queries it answers from a mixture of von Mises-Fisher components anchored at its original embedding, and each chunk has a latent utility that drifts over time. The model gives the optimal inference, a closed-form filter that stores a few keys and two scalars per chunk and updates them online from the labels of a curator, and it frames retrieval as a control problem. It also shows when existing methods are optimal. Query averaging, Rocchio-style feedback and frequency reranking are special cases with fixed parameters, NUDGE is the case of one key per chunk with no dynamics, and LADER the limit of one key per past query. On two public long-term memory benchmarks, BRAG matches these methods on queries asked before, as expected, because when nothing changes over time the assumptions behind these special cases hold. On harder problems, where a new chunk makes an old one obsolete, BRAG outscores them. They all stay at plain-search level (Recall@5 0.67-0.71), while BRAG retrieves the new chunk 0.80-0.86 of the time. We also ran BRAG on three of NUDGE's seven text benchmarks, and it matches or beats NUDGE on all three. On nine months of a personal agent's memory (20,640 chunks), BRAG raises Recall@5 on held-out queries from 0.75 to 0.98 and Recall@1 from 0.44 to 0.97, with little change on chunks never queried.

papers.title: Provably Near-Optimal PQ in the Extended Zador Model
papers.title_zh: 扩展 Zador 模型下可证明近最优的乘积量化(PQ)
papers.summary_zh: 证明 SVD 是 PQ 的最优预处理旋转,并给出带近似保证的 EZPQ 算法。
papers.abstract_zh: 本文研究高斯数据下的乘积量化(PQ)优化,有三点贡献:(i)证明 SVD 是 PQ 的最优预处理旋转;(ii)提出新的 ==Extended Zador(EZ)估计器==,用于估计 k-means 量化代价,在低比特率和低维度下较为准确;(iii)提出基于全局比特分配的一维装箱问题的新分段算法。由此得到一个简单且具有较强近似保证的算法 EZPQ。它在经验精度上与 OPQ 相当,同时在高斯 EZ 代价模型下为每个实例提供失真下界证书。在典型的真实 embedding 谱上,**每维 2 比特的 EZPQ 通常可被证明与该模型下的最优解相差不超过 1%**。它的重构误差也始终低于 EDEN、E-RaBitQ 和 TurboQuant 等所有基于随机旋转的算法。
papers.abstract_en: This paper investigates Product Quantization (PQ) Optimization with Gaussian data. It offers three key contributions (i) a proof that SVD is the optimal preconditioning rotation for PQ; (ii) a new Extended Zador (EZ) estimator of the $k$-means quantization cost that is accurate in low bit rates and low dimensions; and (iii) a novel segmentation algorithm based on 1-d bin packing of global bit allocations. The result is a simple algorithm (EZPQ) with strong approximation guarantees. It matches OPQ's empirical accuracy while providing a per-instance distortion lower bound certificate under the Gaussian EZ cost model. On typical real embedding spectra, EZPQ with 2 bits per coordinate is often certifiably within 1% of the optimum in this model. It also consistently achieves a lower reconstruction error than all random-rotation-based algorithms such as EDEN, E-RaBitQ, and TurboQuant.

papers.title: Towards Realistic Evaluation of Uncertainty Quantification for LLM-Based Recommender Systems
papers.title_zh: 面向基于LLM的推荐系统的不确定性量化的现实评测
papers.summary_zh: 固定排序基准下比较八种UQ信号在LLM推荐中的失败检测能力
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）为推荐系统提供了灵活的接口，但它们给出的排序需要可靠的实例级==不确定性监测==。在这种场景下，比较不确定性量化（UQ）方法并不容易，因为LLM排序器没有标准的物品分类头，其分数可能取决于选项标签、提示词、生成过程以及可用的用户和物品证据。现有方法的不确定性来源不同，作用于推荐流程的不同阶段：有的评估已给出的排序，有的则用不确定性改变排序本身，难以直接比较。我们提出一个==固定排序基准==，在统一的输出约定下，把八种异质的UQ信号作为记录级监测器进行评估。我们在四个推荐数据集和两个LLM骨干上，按统一的固定排序协议评估这些信号，得到三点主要观察。第一，即使在相同的参考实例上，UQ方法的排序也会随骨干不同而变化。第二，与排序对齐的Top10Mass在多种评估条件下给出最强的标量Error@10检测，体现了与截断位置对齐的监测效果，但对流行度长尾目标其优势变窄。第三，标量UQ信号很难判断哪个对照的裁剪NDCG@10差异更大，而来源特定的信号（包括Perturbation Rank Instability和简单的列表级距离）在成对对照一致性上更强，反映出它们对两类受控证据来源的敏感性。这些发现促使我们把**排序失败检测、跨推荐条件的鲁棒性、以及对受控证据变化的响应作为UQ的三种不同属性分别评估**。
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) provide a flexible interface for recommendation systems. However, their issued rankings require reliable instance-level uncertainty monitoring. In this scenario, comparing uncertainty quantification (UQ) methods becomes challenging because LLM rankers lack a standard item-classification head. Their scores may depend on option labels, prompts, generation procedures, and the available user and item evidence. Existing methods derive uncertainty from different sources and apply it at different stages of the recommendation process. Some methods evaluate an issued ranking, whereas others use uncertainty to change the ranking itself, making direct comparison difficult. Here we introduce a fixed-ranking benchmark which evaluates eight heterogeneous UQ signals as record-level monitors under a shared output contract. We evaluate these signals across four recommendation datasets and two LLM backbones under a shared fixed-ranking protocol. From the results, we draw three main observations. First, UQ method ordering changes across backbones even on the same reference instances. Second, ranking-aligned Top10Mass provides the strongest scalar Error@10 detection in several evaluation conditions, reflecting effective cutoff-aligned monitoring, while its advantage narrows for popularity-tail targets. Third, scalar UQ signals are weak at identifying which control has the larger clipped NDCG@10 difference, whereas source-specific signals, including Perturbation Rank Instability and simple listwise distances, provide stronger paired-control agreement, reflecting their sensitivity to the two controlled evidence sources. These findings motivate us to evaluate ranking-failure detection, robustness across recommendation conditions, and responses to controlled evidence changes as distinct properties of UQ.

papers.title: Efficient Video Retrieval Augmented Generation via Token Allocation
papers.title_zh: 基于Token分配的高效视频检索增强生成
papers.summary_zh: 把视频RAG建模为帧与字幕间的token预算分配问题，用water-filling求解。
papers.abstract_zh: 高效的长视频理解需要找出相关证据，同时尽量减少视觉语言模型（VLM）处理的token数。现有视频检索增强生成（RAG）方法依赖帧选择和token压缩，却忽视了每多一个token值多少。我们提出Lembas，一个即插即用的框架，把视频RAG表述为帧与字幕在共同预算下的==token分配问题==。其核心观察是：token的价值在每个条目内部递减，且相似证据获得的token越多，价值下降得越快。Lembas用一个目标函数同时刻画这两种效应，并用带有可证明收敛保证的高效迭代==water-filling==算法求解。对于多轮对话，Lembas复用前几轮已处理的token，并利用VLM的注意力免费地细化相关性。评测显示，在计算量相当时，Lembas比最先进的基线**准确率最高提升7.2个百分点**；在多轮视频理解上，准确率最高提升1.5个百分点，**TFLOPs减少1.7到17.3倍**。
papers.abstract_en: Efficient long-video understanding requires identifying relevant evidence while minimizing the tokens processed by vision-language models (VLMs). Existing video retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) methods rely on frame selection and token compression, but overlook how much each additional token is worth. We introduce Lembas, a plug-and-play framework that formulates video RAG as a token allocation problem over frames and subtitles under a shared budget. Our key insight is that the value of a token diminishes within each item and decreases further as similar evidence receives more tokens. Lembas captures both effects in a single objective and solves it with an efficient iterative water-filling algorithm that has a provable convergence guarantee. For multi-turn conversations, Lembas reuses the tokens processed in earlier turns and refines relevance with the VLM's attention at no extra cost. Our evaluations show that Lembas improves accuracy by up to 7.2 percentage points over state-of-the-art baselines at comparable compute. On multi-turn video understanding, Lembas achieves up to 1.5 percentage points higher accuracy with 1.7-17.3x fewer TFLOPs.

papers.title: MargEmbed-Akan: Bridging Twi Questions and English Knowledge through Cross-Lingual Score Distillation
papers.title_zh: MargEmbed-Akan：通过跨语言分数蒸馏连接Twi语问题与英文知识
papers.summary_zh: 用跨语言分数蒸馏训练Twi查询编码器，AfriQA上nDCG@10达71.5
papers.abstract_zh: Twi（阿肯语）使用者在网上寻找的信息大多是英文的，因此跨语言检索十分必要。我们在两个Twi-英语任务上评估了八个系统：BM25、五个开源embedding模型和两个闭源模型（gemini-embedding-001与OpenAI text-embedding-3-large）。AfriQA包含1,221条原生书写的阿散蒂Twi语问题，需要检索出回答它们的英文维基百科段落；圣经翻译检索则要求用一段Twi语经文，从6,195个候选中检索出其英文译文。我们提出MargEmbed-Akan，一个560M参数的开源query编码器，以AfriE5-Large-instruct为基础，通过==跨语言分数蒸馏==训练。冻结的基础模型对每个英文训练问题，分别计算其与答案段落及七个hard negative的得分。学生模型要从两种输入复现这些得分：一是通过回译检查的NLLB-200 Twi译文，二是原始英文问题，以保持英文能力。训练时段落由冻结的基础模型编码；评测时由MargEmbed-Akan同时编码问题和段落。在AfriQA上，基础AfriE5与gemini-embedding-001的nDCG@10均为66.6；EmbeddingGemma 2、Qwen3-VL-Embedding-2B和OpenAI text-embedding-3-large分别为56.6、51.3和53.4。**MargEmbed-Akan达到71.5，比gemini-embedding-001高4.9分，比其基础模型高5.0分，比OpenAI text-embedding-3-large高18.1分。**其最大增益出现在不带E和O书写的Twi上（比gemini-embedding-001高7.5）。英文检索与基础模型没有显著差异，不过两个闭源模型高出1.5-2.2分。在圣经翻译检索上，MargEmbed-Akan与gemini-embedding-001在标准Twi上统计持平（nDCG@10为97.2对96.5）；在无变音符号的Twi上MargEmbed-Akan更好（92.7对84.9）。训练和模型选择中均未使用AfriQA数据。
papers.abstract_en: Most information sought online by Twi (Akan) speakers is written in English, making cross-lingual retrieval essential. We evaluate eight systems: BM25, five open embedding models, and two proprietary models (gemini-embedding-001 and OpenAI text-embedding-3-large) on two Twi-English tasks. AfriQA contains 1,221 natively written Asante Twi questions that must retrieve their answering English Wikipedia passages. Bible translation retrieval requires a Twi passage to retrieve its English translation from 6,195 candidates. We introduce MargEmbed-Akan, a 560M-parameter open query encoder trained from AfriE5-Large-instruct using cross-lingual score distillation. The frozen base model scores each English training question against its answer passage and seven hard negatives. The student learns to reproduce these scores from both an NLLB-200 Twi translation that passes a round-trip translation check and the original English question, preserving English behaviour. During training, passages are encoded by the frozen base model; at evaluation, MargEmbed-Akan encodes questions and passages. On AfriQA, base AfriE5 and gemini-embedding-001 both achieve 66.6 nDCG@10; EmbeddingGemma 2, Qwen3-VL-Embedding-2B, and OpenAI text-embedding-3-large achieve 56.6, 51.3, and 53.4, respectively. MargEmbed-Akan achieves 71.5, outperforming gemini-embedding-001 by 4.9 points, its base model by 5.0, and OpenAI text-embedding-3-large by 18.1. Its largest gain is on Twi typed without E and O (+7.5 over gemini-embedding-001). English retrieval does not differ significantly from the base model, although both proprietary models score 1.5-2.2 points higher. On Bible translation retrieval, MargEmbed-Akan and gemini-embedding-001 are statistically tied on standard Twi (97.2 vs. 96.5 nDCG@10); MargEmbed-Akan performs better on diacritic-free Twi (92.7 vs. 84.9). No AfriQA data was used for training or model selection.

papers.title: Rethinking Document Indexing for LLM-based Analysis
papers.title_zh: 重新思考面向LLM分析的文档索引
papers.summary_zh: 借鉴B+树提出由LLM构建的层次化纯文本索引Periplus，token消耗减少70%以上
papers.abstract_zh: 临床记录、法律合同和科学论文等文档正越来越多地由大语言模型（LLM）来分析。对每个问题都把全文放进prompt的朴素做法速度慢、成本高，在长输入上容易产生幻觉，而且不同问题之间无法复用已有工作。检索增强生成（RAG）系统通过构建可复用的状态来解决这一问题，但它们把状态存成embedding chunk：把文本切成片段可能丢失跨越片段的语义，而且索引绑定在某个embedding模型上，模型一换就必须重建。不过，在不全量重扫的情况下对大量数据回答许多问题并不是新问题，这正是数据库索引几十年来一直在解决的问题，我们认为这些积累下来的索引设计知识值得为LLM访问重新审视。作为一个具体的起点，我们提出==Periplus==，一种受经典B+树启发的层次化纯文本索引。它把文档组织成页面，从根部的概括性摘要到叶子处的具体摘要，每一层都引导搜索进入下一层。但它在三个方面不同于B+树，以适应LLM访问：内容存在于每一层，页面是纯文本而非属性值，导航依据页面摘要与问题的相关性而非键比较。结构本身由LLM针对每篇文档自行发现，而不是预先手工设计。在叙事类和合同类语料上的初步评测中，Periplus的准确率与最强基线相差**0.1–0.9个百分点，而总token消耗减少70–72%**。这些早期结果令人鼓舞，但只是展示了索引设计能为LLM分析带来的一小部分可能。
papers.abstract_en: Documents such as clinical records, legal contracts, and scientific papers are increasingly analyzed with large language models (LLMs). The naïve approach of prompting the model with the full text for every question is slow, expensive, prone to hallucination on long inputs, and reuses no work across questions. Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems build reusable state to address this, but they store it as embedded chunks: slicing text into fragments can lose the meaning that spans them, and the resulting index is tied to one embedding model, so it must be rebuilt whenever that model changes. Answering many questions over a large body of data without a full rescan, however, is not a new problem: it is the problem database indexes have been solving for decades, and we argue that this accumulated index design knowledge is waiting to be revisited for LLM access. As a concrete starting point, we propose Periplus, a hierarchical plain-text index inspired by the classic B+ tree. It arranges a document into pages running from general summaries at the root to specific ones at the leaves, so that each level guides the search into the next. But it departs from the B+ tree in three ways suited to LLM access: content lives at every level, the pages are plain text rather than attribute values, and navigation follows the relevance of a page summary to the question rather than a key comparison. The structure itself is discovered per document by the LLM rather than hand-designed in advance. In a preliminary evaluation on narrative and contract corpora, Periplus comes within 0.1--0.9 percentage points of the strongest baseline's accuracy while consuming 70--72\% fewer total tokens. These early results are encouraging, and they offer only a glimpse of what index design can bring to LLM-based analysis.

papers.title: SAG-Mem-1.0 Technical Report
papers.title_zh: SAG-Mem-1.0 技术报告
papers.summary_zh: 保留完整对话分块，用BM25加查询时词法扩展做长期对话记忆检索
papers.abstract_zh: ==长期对话记忆==需要检索散布在多个会话中的互补事实，其中包括与原问题相似度有限的中间证据。现有方法常依赖派生的记忆表示或持久的关系结构，带来构建成本，还可能丢失源细节。我们提出SAG-Mem，一个对话记忆框架：将完整对话消息保存在不重叠的分块中，并通过==查询时词法扩展==发现互补证据。记忆构建无需模型推理，只使用词法索引，不做基于LLM的抽取、摘要或语义关系构建。查询时，BM25先检索初始候选，证据评估器挑出有用的分块，再用所选证据中的词法线索引导额外一轮检索。检索到的对话还会标注对受支持的相对时间表达的日历解释，同时保留原始措辞和时间粒度。我们还提出SAG-Mem-Lite，用基于embedding的候选打分替换证据评分，在两个基准上运行成本均低于Full Context及所有基于记忆的基线，且查询延迟低。在LoCoMo和LongMemEval上，SAG-Mem的总体得分分别为83.08和80.20，均为所评方法中最高；**在LongMemEval上比最强对比基线高出7.20分**。SAG-Mem-Lite的得分分别为77.09和77.20。这些结果表明，保留对话原文与证据引导的检索扩展是长期对话记忆的有效设计。
papers.abstract_en: Long-term conversational memory requires retrieving complementary facts scattered across dialogue sessions, including intermediate evidence with limited similarity to the original question. Existing approaches often rely on derived memory representations or persistent relational structures, introducing construction costs and potentially losing source details. We present SAG-Mem, a conversational memory framework that preserves complete dialogue messages in non-overlapping chunks and discovers complementary evidence through query-time lexical expansion. Memory construction requires no model inference, using a lexical index without LLM-based extraction, summarization, or semantic relation construction. At query time, BM25 retrieves initial candidates, an evidence evaluator identifies useful chunks, and lexical cues from selected evidence guide an additional retrieval round. Retrieved dialogue is further annotated with calendar interpretations of supported relative-time expressions, preserving the original wording and temporal granularity. We also introduce SAG-Mem-Lite, an alternative configuration that replaces evidence scoring with embedding-based candidate scoring, achieving lower operational cost than Full Context and all memory-based baselines across both benchmarks with low query latency. On LoCoMo and LongMemEval, SAG-Mem achieves overall scores of 83.08 and 80.20, respectively, the highest among the evaluated methods on both benchmarks. On LongMemEval, it exceeds the strongest compared baseline by 7.20 points. SAG-Mem-Lite achieves scores of 77.09 and 77.20, respectively. These results support dialogue preservation and evidence-guided retrieval expansion as an effective design for long-term conversational memory.

papers.title: C3H: Compression-to-Consensus Criteria Hijacking in Multimodal LLM Recommender Systems
papers.title_zh: C3H：多模态LLM推荐系统中的压缩到共识准则劫持
papers.summary_zh: 提出推理时攻击C3H，利用压缩与跨模态共识偏差在多模态LLM推荐中推高目标item曝光。
papers.abstract_zh: 多模态大语言模型（MLLM）正把推荐系统变成感知内容的决策系统。在这类系统中，多模态压缩和跨模态融合常被视为抵御内容操纵的鲁棒性增强机制：压缩可以滤除噪声信号，跨模态共识可以抑制不一致的异常。我们质疑这一假设，指出同样的过程会在排序决策中暴露出==压缩到共识（C2C）偏差==：压缩后仍然显著、并在各模态间得到一致支持的信号，会在候选比较中获得不成比例的影响，为内容操纵提供了可利用的方向。本文提出C3H，一种利用这一漏洞的新型推理时攻击。C3H不依赖噪声扰动或训练时投毒，而是调整目标item的多模态内容，使其与推荐器隐含表达的决策准则对齐，从而推高目标item。大量实验表明，C3H**显著提高目标item的曝光，同时保持整体推荐效用**。代码见 https://github.com/GuoweiGuan666/C3H。
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are transforming recommender systems into content-aware decision systems. In these systems, multimodal compression and cross-modal fusion are often viewed as robustness-enhancing mechanisms against content manipulation, as compression can filter noisy signals and cross-modal consensus can suppress inconsistent anomalies. We challenge this assumption by showing that the same process can expose a compression-to-consensus (C2C) bias in ranking decisions. Signals that remain salient after compression and receive consistent support across modalities can gain disproportionate influence in candidate comparison, offering an exploitable direction for content manipulation. In this paper, we introduce C3H, a novel inference-time attack that exploits this vulnerability. Rather than relying on noisy perturbations or training-time poisoning, C3H promotes a target item by tailoring its multimodal content to align with the decision criteria implicitly expressed by the recommender. Extensive experiments demonstrate that C3H substantially increases target-item exposure while maintaining overall recommendation utility. Code is available at https://github.com/GuoweiGuan666/C3H.

papers.title: Efficient Semantic ORDER BY via Transitivity-Aware LLM Batch Sorting
papers.title_zh: 基于传递性感知LLM批量排序的高效语义ORDER BY
papers.summary_zh: TBS记录已推断的偏好并利用传递性，使LLM语义排序调用减少12-20倍。
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型使声明式语义排序成为可能：LLM-ORDER BY算子按自然语言标准对非结构化数据中的元组排序。高效执行这类算子并不容易，因为LLM比较昂贵、带随机性，有时还不一致。成对比较的方法需要大量昂贵调用；外部归并排序等列表式方法每次调用可对多个条目排序，但它们遵循固定的归并调度且不记录先前答案：每次归并调用都会重复询问之前调用已直接或经传递性揭示的顺序。我们提出==Transitive Batched Sort（TBS）==，一种传递性感知的语义排序物理算子，它把每个已揭示的偏好记录在全局无环偏好图中，只对相对顺序尚未被隐含的条目发起列表式请求。为了扩展规模，TBS只存储直接观察到的偏好，并通过省内存的可达性索引回答传递性查询；为了应对LLM输出的噪声，它会校验响应并拒绝引入环的更新。我们在六个基准上评测TBS，覆盖结构化排序、商品价格排序、段落排序和个性化推荐，使用四种LLM。**TBS相比成对快速排序减少12-20倍API调用**，在相同批大小下比列表式归并排序少用1.1-1.6倍调用、成本低1.3-5.3倍，同时在大多数基准上排序质量相当或更高；在Amazon上可扩展到一百万件商品。这些结果表明，复用已推断的偏好关系而非重复查询，是可扩展语义ORDER BY算子的有效基础。
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) enable declarative semantic sorting through LLM-ORDER BY operators that rank tuples according to natural-language criteria over unstructured data. Executing such operators efficiently is challenging because LLM comparisons are expensive, stochastic, and sometimes inconsistent. Pairwise approaches require many costly calls. Listwise approaches such as external merge sort rank several items per call, but they follow a fixed merge schedule and keep no record of earlier answers: each merge call re-asks orderings that previous calls have already revealed, directly or by transitivity. We present Transitive Batched Sort (TBS), a transitivity-aware physical operator for semantic sorting that records every revealed preference in a global acyclic preference graph and issues a listwise request only for items whose relative order is not yet implied. To scale, TBS stores only directly observed preferences and answers transitivity queries through a memory-efficient reachability index; to handle noisy LLM outputs, it validates responses and rejects cycle-inducing updates. We evaluate TBS on six benchmarks spanning structured sorting, product price ranking, passage ranking, and personalized recommendation with four LLMs. TBS reduces API calls by 12-20x relative to pairwise quicksort and, at the same batch size, uses 1.1-1.6x fewer calls and 1.3-5.3x lower cost than listwise merge sort while achieving competitive or higher ranking quality across most benchmarks; on Amazon it scales to one million products. These results show that reusing previously inferred preference relations, rather than re-querying them, is an effective foundation for scalable semantic ORDER BY operators.

papers.title: TableRouter: Query-Aware Evidence Construction for Long-Table Question Answering
papers.title_zh: TableRouter：面向长表格问答的查询感知证据构建
papers.summary_zh: 按query在统计计算与行检索两条路线间选择，为长表格问答构建证据。
papers.abstract_zh: LLM能够对表格进行推理，但当表格超出上下文预算时，检索相关行只是解决方案的一部分：检索到的子集可能遗漏精确聚合所需的信息，即使证据完整，LLM也未必能有效使用。我们提出==TableRouter==，一个无需训练的框架，先分析每个query，再在两条路线中选择：==计算路线==从完整表格中得到与问题相关的统计量，==覆盖路线==检索相关行和列摘要。选定的上下文只需一次调用即可交给冻结的LLM。在三个LLM和三个大表格基准上，TableRouter在全部九种设置中都优于六个单次调用基线中最强的一个，领先1.2-18.3个准确率点，估计FLOPs比截断表格提示少77-95%（索引开销在多个问题间摊销）。这一收益也延伸到此前实验未使用的数据库中的长表格：Qwen2.5-7B下TableRouter达到35.8%，而最强外部基线为16.4%。对照实验表明，即使所有决定答案的行都已具备，显式提供计算得到的统计量仍可将准确率**最多提升40.0个点**。这些结果区分了证据获取与证据使用：长表格推理取决于信息如何表示，而不只是检索了哪些行。
papers.abstract_en: LLMs can reason over tables, but when tables outgrow the context budget, retrieving relevant rows is only part of the solution. A retrieved subset may omit information required for an exact aggregate; even complete evidence may remain difficult for an LLM to use. We introduce TableRouter, a training-free framework that analyzes each query, then chooses between two routes: a computation route, which derives question-conditioned statistics from the full table, and a coverage route, which retrieves relevant rows and column summaries. The chosen context is passed to a frozen LLM in one call. Across three LLMs and three large-table benchmarks, TableRouter outperforms the strongest of six single-call baselines in all nine settings by 1.2-18.3 accuracy points, using 77-95% fewer estimated FLOPs than truncated-table prompting, with indexing amortized across questions. The gains extend to long tables from databases not used in earlier experiments, where TableRouter achieves 35.8% with Qwen2.5-7B, versus 16.4% for the strongest external baseline. A controlled experiment shows that explicitly providing computed statistics improves accuracy by up to 40.0 points, even when all answer-determining rows are available. These results distinguish evidence access from evidence use: long-table reasoning depends on how information is represented, not only on which rows are retrieved.

papers.title: A dataset of clinically similar image pairs from citation-linked case reports for medical image retrieval
papers.title_zh: 基于引文关联病例报告的临床相似图像对数据集,用于医学图像检索
papers.summary_zh: 构建 8.6 万对临床相似医学图像数据集 PMC-PaIR,用于训练检索模型。
papers.abstract_zh: 检索与某位患者临床相似的其他患者图像,可以辅助诊断、教学和研究。训练和评估检索系统需要知道不同患者的哪些图像显示了相同的发现,而现有数据集规模小、范围窄。我们构建了 PMC-PaIR,这是一个包含 86,144 对临床相似图像的数据集,来自 56,013 篇开放获取的 PubMed Central 病例报告,这些报告常记录罕见或有挑战性的表现。我们提出一种沿引文关系的方法,因为引文常把相似患者的病例报告联系起来。为判断两个相关联的病例在临床上共有什么,该方法提示大语言模型生成并回答从模态到诊断和发现的分层问题,并利用答案通过图注匹配图像。专家认为这些图像对高度准确,而这种 ==问题引导== 的方法比直接匹配**多找到一倍的正确图像对**。在 PMC-PaIR 上微调 BiomedCLIP,在所测试的所有模态、解剖部位和诊断类别上都改进了检索,无论是仅图像查询还是带有说明发现的简短文字的图像查询。我们发布了数据集和自动化流程,后者可随新病例报告的发表扩展 PMC-PaIR。
papers.abstract_en: Retrieving images of patients clinically similar to a given patient can support diagnosis, teaching and research. Training and evaluating retrieval systems requires knowing which images of different patients show the same finding, and existing datasets are small or narrow in scope. We construct PMC-PaIR, a dataset of 86,144 pairs of clinically similar images from 56,013 open-access PubMed Central case reports, which often document rare or challenging presentations. We develop an approach that follows citations, which often link case reports of similar patients. To determine what two linked cases share clinically, it prompts large language models to generate and answer hierarchical questions, from modality to diagnosis and findings, and to match images by caption using the answers. Experts find the pairs highly accurate, and this question-guided approach finds twice as many correct pairs as direct matching. Fine-tuning BiomedCLIP on PMC-PaIR improves retrieval in all modality, anatomy and diagnosis categories tested, for image-only queries and image queries with a short text naming the finding. We release the dataset and the automated pipeline, which can extend PMC-PaIR as new case reports are published.

papers.title: Small Learned Projections for Semantic-Reversal-Aware Retrieval with Spectral Acceleration: A Four-Domain Empirical Study
papers.title_zh: 面向语义反转感知检索的小型学习投影与谱加速:四领域实证研究
papers.summary_zh: 用小型学习投影压制稠密检索中的语义反转陷阱文档,并给出加速方案。
papers.abstract_zh: 稠密 embedding 检索器可能遭到对抗性失败:某个查询由文档 A 回答,而与 A 近乎相同、仅有细小改变含义的编辑的文档 B(“陷阱”)会推翻这一答案。在 5,000 的候选池下,E5-Large-v2 上的原始余弦相似度**会在 82-100% 的查询中把 B 排进 top-10**。我们研究两件事。第一,一个小型学习投影 W: R^1024 -> R^d(d 取 11 或 32),通过确定性的配方在一组已声明的案例上训练,用以压制陷阱:在已声明的案例上,法律、医疗、专利、金融四个独立领域、候选池最大到 100,000 的全部十二种(领域,池大小)设置下,在精确最近邻搜索中 HN@10 = 0.0000(top-10 中没有陷阱),而正确的释义仍在 93-99% 的案例中被保留。第二,一个边界条件加速器,可在该规模上提供该投影服务:它是对谱图检索(SpectRAG)的加速,用边界值求解取代稠密特征分解,在 n = 100,000 时于每个领域都保持 HN@10 = 0.0000,检索约 300 条查询的测试集耗时 0.6-1.1 秒(平均每条约 2-4 毫秒)。由于该投影的输出就是存储的表示(每篇文档仅几个浮点数),每个领域或租户的加固专用索引比完整 embedding 小约 90 倍,速度也按维度比例变快,使得许多小型声明索引成为替代一个大型向量库的可行方案。结论的适用范围限于所测候选池上已声明的案例,没有概率界;对未变语料库使用改写后的查询时,正确答案率会下降(约 0.79,但陷阱抑制依然成立)。该投影只能部分迁移到其他领域,我们对此做了完整报告。配方、投影、陷阱集和评估框架以 AGPL-3.0 发布;加速器的实现是保留的商业组件,所有 HN 数字在精确搜索下均可复现。
papers.abstract_en: Dense-embedding retrievers can fail adversarially: when a query is answered by a document A and reversed by a near-copy B that differs from A by a small meaning-changing edit (a "trap"), raw cosine over E5-Large-v2 places B in the top-10 for 82-100% of queries at a pool of 5,000. We study two things. First, a small learned projection W: R^1024 -> R^d (d in {11, 32}), trained by a deterministic recipe on a declared set of cases, that suppresses the trap: for the declared cases, HN@10 = 0.0000 (no trap in the top-10) in all twelve (domain, pool-size) settings across four independent domains (legal, medical, patent, financial) and pools up to 100,000, while the correct paraphrase is retained for 93-99% of cases, under exact nearest-neighbour search. Second, a boundary-conditioned accelerator that serves the projection at that scale: an acceleration of spectral graph retrieval (SpectRAG) that replaces a dense eigendecomposition with a boundary-value solve, holding HN@10 = 0.0000 at n = 100,000 in every domain and retrieving the ~300-query suite in 0.6-1.1 s (~2-4 ms per query on average). Because the lens's output is the stored representation (a few floats per document), a hardened, specialised index per domain or tenant is ~90x smaller and dimension-proportionally faster than the full embedding, making many small declared indexes a practical alternative to one large vector store. The claim is scoped to the declared cases on the measured pools, with no probabilistic bound; the correct-answer rate drops for a reworded query against an unchanged corpus (about 0.79, trap suppression still holding). A projection transfers only partly to other domains, which we report in full. The recipe, lenses, trap sets and evaluation harness are released under AGPL-3.0; the accelerator's implementation is a reserved commercial component, and every HN number is reproducible under exact search.

papers.title: ShapeQuest: Towards Granularity-Controlled Edit-Conditioned 3D Asset Retrieval
papers.title_zh: ShapeQuest:迈向粒度可控、以编辑为条件的 3D 资产检索
papers.summary_zh: 提出编辑条件 3D 资产检索基准 ShapeQuest 及联合重建的检索模型 ShapeQuester。
papers.abstract_zh: 给定一个参考资产和类似“去掉一个扶手”的指令,检索器必须找到做出该编辑且保留其他部分的变体。这类搜索在图像上已经很成熟,但对单个 3D 资产仍缺乏研究。为研究该问题,我们提出了 ShapeQuest 和 ShapeQuester,即编辑条件 3D 资产检索的新基准和新模型。ShapeQuest 的开源流程通过增删部件以及改变材质和颜色来编辑带纹理的网格。它按每个编辑所影响的物体表面积比例,把编辑粒度控制在五个级别。当指令没有限定具体部件时,它会构造多个有效目标。一个视觉语言模型从为暴露被编辑部位而选取的视角判断每次编辑,并由人工评审员审核其判断。ShapeQuest 有 50 个类别的 87,824 条查询,以及含相互竞争编辑的 50,919 个形状的图库。为区分这些变体,ShapeQuester 在学习检索的同时 ==重建被编辑后的点云==,并用部件掩码监督变化区域和保留区域。在冻结预训练点编码器的情况下,ShapeQuester 在测试集上达到 **50.4 的 operation-macro mAP@10,而相同输入的融合基线为 47.2,最强基线为 48.6**。当点编码器从头训练时,重建在验证集上带来 6.5 个点的提升,其中部件掩码贡献 3.3 个点。
papers.abstract_en: Given a reference asset and an instruction such as "remove one armrest," a retriever must find variants that make the edit and preserve the other parts. This search is well established for images but remains underexplored for individual 3D assets. To study this problem, we introduce ShapeQuest and ShapeQuester, a new benchmark and model for edit-conditioned 3D asset retrieval. ShapeQuest's open-source pipeline edits textured meshes through part additions, removals, and material and colour changes. It controls edit granularity across five levels, defined by the fraction of the object's surface area each edit affects. It constructs multiple valid targets when an instruction leaves the choice of part open. A vision-language model judges each edit from views chosen to expose the edited parts, and human raters audit its judgments. ShapeQuest has 87,824 queries in 50 categories and a 50,919-shape gallery with competing edits. To distinguish these variants, ShapeQuester learns retrieval alongside reconstruction of the edited point cloud, with part masks supervising changed and preserved regions. With a frozen pretrained point encoder, ShapeQuester reaches 50.4 operation-macro mAP@10 on the test split, against 47.2 for the fusion baseline with the same inputs and 48.6 for the strongest baseline. Reconstruction adds 6.5 points on the validation split when the point encoder is trained from scratch, including 3.3 from part masks.

papers.title: CREDIT: Compositional Reliability Learning for Noisy Composed Image Retrieval
papers.title_zh: CREDIT:面向含噪组合图像检索的组合可靠性学习
papers.summary_zh: 用证据学习估计三元组可靠性并以扩散精炼参考表示,应对含噪组合图像检索。
papers.abstract_zh: 组合图像检索(CIR)旨在根据由参考图像和修改文本构成的多模态查询,检索满足用户意图的目标图像。然而,真实训练数据常被含噪三元组对应(NTC)污染,参考图像、修改文本和目标图像之间的语义对应变得不可靠。现有方法隐含地假设三元组对应是否正确可由固定的决策规则判定。但在 NTC 下,语义对应的真实性很难准确判断,不同三元组呈现的是不同程度的语义可靠性,而非二元的对错。因此,确定性的置信度不足以如实刻画对应的可靠性,往往导致对不可靠三元组的过度自信监督,并在组合表示学习中不断强化噪声语义。为应对这一挑战,我们提出基于证据不确定性和扩散引导精炼的组合可靠性学习框架 CREDIT,它显式量化三元组对应的不确定性以估计其可靠性,并抑制噪声监督的传播。CREDIT 包含两个互补组件:==证据组合不确定性学习(ECUL)== 模块通过证据学习显式建模对应的不确定性,实现感知不确定性的可靠性估计,从而抑制噪声监督。在 ECUL 提供的可靠监督基础上,==扩散增强参考精炼(DRR)== 模块通过文本条件扩散进一步精炼参考表示,产生更稳健的组合查询特征。大量实验表明,CREDIT 在各种设置下均稳定优于现有方法。
papers.abstract_en: Composed Image Retrieval (CIR) aims to retrieve a target image that satisfies user intent based on a multimodal query consisting of a reference image and a modification text. However, real-world training data are often corrupted by Noisy Triplet Correspondence (NTC), where the semantic correspondence among the reference image, modification text, and target image becomes unreliable. Existing methods implicitly assume that the correctness of triplet correspondence can be determined by fixed decision rules. However, under NTC, the authenticity of semantic correspondence is difficult to determine accurately, and different triplets exhibit varying degrees of semantic reliability rather than binary correctness. Consequently, deterministic confidence is insufficient to faithfully characterize correspondence reliability, often leading to overconfident supervision for unreliable triplets and progressively reinforcing noisy semantics during compositional representation learning. To address this challenge, we propose a Compositional Reliability learning framework with Evidential uncertainty and DiffusIon-guided refinemenT (CREDIT), which explicitly quantifies the uncertainty of triplet correspondence to estimate its reliability and suppress the propagation of noisy supervision. CREDIT consists of two complementary components: The Evidential Compositional Uncertainty Learning (ECUL) module explicitly models correspondence uncertainty via evidential learning, enabling uncertaintyaware reliability estimation to suppress noisy supervision. Building upon the reliable supervision provided by ECUL, the Diffusion-enhanced Reference Refinement (DRR) module further refines reference representations through textconditioned diffusion, producing more robust compositional query features. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CREDIT consistently outperforms existing methods under various settings.

papers.title: From Memory Access to Evidence Sufficiency: Diagnosing and Addressing Demand--Evidence Misalignment
papers.title_zh: 从记忆访问到证据充分性：诊断并解决需求-证据错位
papers.summary_zh: 诊断长期记忆检索的需求-证据错位，并提出按类型化需求引导检索的BiDE-Mem。
papers.abstract_zh: 长期记忆检索常常返回与query相关的记录，但相关并不保证证据充分：回答问题需要一组记录共同满足问题的事实、关系、时间和状态约束。我们通过==MemPath==研究这种需求-证据错位，它是一个干预式框架，用来诊断记忆访问、需求覆盖和证据利用中的失败。基于该诊断，我们提出==BiDE-Mem==，它把问题表示为类型化需求，并用这些需求引导检索与证据组织。我们形式化了需求-证据支持；在评测的精简路径中，它通过带来源感知的证据组织和Reader引导来体现，而不是通过单独的生成式四状态验证步骤。在LoCoMo上，BiDE-Mem比Mnemis准确率高**6.23个百分点**；在LongMemEval上达到**91.80%**，在多跳和时间类问题上表现突出。补充的Qwen-Reader评测在两种评判协议下，使其在LoCoMo和LongMemEval-S上位列七个系统之首。消融和证据层面的分析表明，需求表示、检索和证据呈现都对回答质量有贡献。
papers.abstract_en: Long-term memory retrieval often returns query-relevant records, but relevance does not guarantee sufficient evidence: answering requires a set of records that jointly satisfies a question's factual, relational, temporal, and state constraints. We study this demand--evidence misalignment through MemPath, an interventional framework that diagnoses failures in memory access, demand coverage, and evidence utilization. Guided by this diagnosis, we propose BiDE-Mem, which represents questions as typed demands and uses them to guide retrieval and evidence organization. We formalize demand--evidence support; in the evaluated compact path, it is conveyed through provenance-aware evidence organization and Reader guidance rather than a separate generative four-state verification step. On LoCoMo, BiDE-Mem improves accuracy by 6.23 percentage points over Mnemis; on LongMemEval, it achieves 91.80%, with strong multi-hop and temporal performance. Supplementary Qwen-Reader evaluations place it first among seven systems on LoCoMo and LongMemEval-S under two judging protocols. Ablations and evidence-level analyses show that demand representation, retrieval, and evidence presentation each contribute to answer quality.

papers.title: ModernELECTRA: Replaced-Token Detection with Boundary-Window Reconstruction for Compact Encoders that Classify and Embed
papers.title_zh: ModernELECTRA:用边界窗口重构做替换词检测,得到既能分类又能做 embedding 的紧凑编码器
papers.summary_zh: 在 RTD 预训练上加边界窗口重构任务,使紧凑编码器同时适合分类和 embedding。
papers.abstract_zh: ELECTRA 式的替换词检测(RTD)是一种样本效率高的文本编码器预训练目标,DeBERTaV3 等 RTD 训练的模型在分类基准上表现很强。但这类模型已知并不适合做检索、语义相似度等 embedding 任务的骨干:“原词/被替换”的二元信号并不要求最后一层保留 token 身份和上下文内容,而这些正是稠密表示所依赖的。我们提出 ModernELECTRA,一种保留 RTD 为主目标、并加入轻量辅助任务 ==边界窗口重构== 的预训练方案。对每个 token,我们采样一个严格包含它的 3-12 个 token 的窗口,仅依据判别器在窗口两端边界处的隐状态来重构该 token 的原始身份。该任务训练时只多一个小型 FFN,训练后即被丢弃,却迫使每个最后一层状态携带其邻域信息。再结合冻结且单独预训练的生成器、用于困难负例的温度课程以及 512 到 8192 的长度课程,我们各用约 1T token 训练了两个紧凑编码器:8 层英文模型 EdgeCoder-31M,和覆盖 46 种语言的 16 层模型 EdgeCoder-Multilingual-61M。它们在 GLUE 上分别达到 86.0 和 85.1。英文模型在 GLUE 上优于 Ettin-Enc-32m(83.5)和 MiniLM-L12(84.6),同时在 MTEB English v2 上与它们持平(51.1);多语言模型在 GLUE 上优于大 2.3 倍的 mmBERT-small,在其覆盖的语言上于 XTREME 上优于 Multilingual MiniLM 和 mDistilBERT。我们还介绍了开源的 FlashDeBERTa,它是 DeBERTa 解耦注意力的融合实现,不存储 n×n 得分矩阵:**在 4096 token 时速度快 10 倍、显存少 93%**,并且可直接加载现有 DeBERTa 检查点。
papers.abstract_en: ELECTRA-style replaced-token detection (RTD) is a sample-efficient objective for pre-training text encoders, and RTD-trained models such as DeBERTaV3 are strong on classification benchmarks. The same models, however, are known to be poor backbones for embedding tasks such as retrieval and semantic similarity: the binary "original vs. replaced" signal does not ask the final layer to retain the token identity and contextual content that dense representations rely on. We introduce ModernELECTRA, a pre-training recipe that keeps RTD as the main objective and adds a lightweight auxiliary task, boundary-window reconstruction. For every token, we sample a window of 3-12 tokens that strictly contains it and reconstruct the token's original identity only from the discriminator's hidden states at the two window boundaries. The task costs one small FFN at training time and is discarded afterwards, yet it forces every final-layer state to carry information about its neighbourhood. Combined with a frozen, separately pre-trained generator, a temperature curriculum for hard negatives and a 512-to-8192 length curriculum, we train two compact encoders: EdgeCoder-31M, an 8-layer English model, and EdgeCoder-Multilingual-61M, a 16-layer model covering 46 languages, each on about 1T tokens. They reach 86.0 and 85.1 on GLUE. The English model outperforms Ettin-Enc-32m (83.5) and MiniLM-L12 (84.6) on GLUE while matching them on MTEB English v2 (51.1), and the multilingual model outperforms the 2.3x larger mmBERT-small on GLUE and Multilingual MiniLM and mDistilBERT on XTREME over the languages it covers. We also describe FlashDeBERTa, our open-source fused implementation of DeBERTa's disentangled attention that stores no $n \times n$ score matrix: at 4096 tokens it is 10x faster and uses 93% less memory than the reference implementation, and it loads existing DeBERTa checkpoints unchanged.

papers.title: Focus On Facts: Stylistically Invariant and Factually Sensitive Text Embeddings
papers.title_zh: 聚焦事实：风格不变且对事实敏感的文本Embedding
papers.summary_zh: 用难负例对比学习缓解文本embedding把表面相似当作事实一致的问题，并构建FOF-Bench。
papers.abstract_zh: 文本embedding模型会把表面形式的相似误当作事实上的一致。给定一个含一处被篡改事实的近似拷贝，以及一个措辞不同但保留事实的改写，基础模型更倾向于选择被篡改的近似拷贝。我们检验难负例对比监督能否削弱这种表面相似性捷径。我们构建了FOF-Bench，一个跨五个领域、含83,263个三元组的基准，每个锚点配有一条LLM生成的保留事实的风格改写，以及一条对应的事实被篡改的近似拷贝。我们用三元组对比目标微调了一个80M参数的embedding模型FOF-80M（Focus On Facts），使其把改写排在事实篡改之上。在8,327个留出测试三元组上，基础模型在99.58%的情况下选择事实被篡改的文本（事实偏好率0.42%，平均间隔-0.1650）。微调后，正负例平均间隔为+0.0329，98.5%的单个间隔朝预期方向移动，**偏好率达到29.37%**。在外部风格迁移语料DiSC上，平均跨风格相似度从0.7905提高到0.9559。该模型也会惩罚信息遗漏，但向NLI和摘要等有方向性的任务迁移较差。我们把FOF-80M定位为研究风格变化下事实保持的==软性事实指纹==，而不是通用的事实性度量。
papers.abstract_en: Text embedding models can conflate surface-form similarity with factual identity. Given an altered near-copy with one corrupted fact and a differently worded fact-preserving rewrite, the base model prefers the altered near-copy. We test whether hard-negative contrastive supervision can reduce this surface-similarity shortcut. We construct FOF-Bench, an 83,263-triplet benchmark spanning five domains. Each anchor is paired with an LLM-generated, fact-preserving stylistic rewrite and a matched fact-altered near-copy. We fine-tune FOF-80M (Focus On Facts), an 80M-parameter embedding model, with a triplet contrastive objective that ranks the rewrite above the factual alteration. On 8,327 held-out test triplets, the base model chooses the factually altered text in 99.58% of cases (0.42% factual preference rate; mean separation -0.1650). After fine-tuning, mean positive--negative separation is +0.0329, 98.5% of individual margins move in the intended direction, and the preference rate reaches 29.37%. On DiSC, an external style-transfer corpus, mean cross-style similarity increases from 0.7905 to 0.9559. The model also penalizes omission and transfers poorly to directional tasks such as NLI and summarization. We characterize FOF-80M as a soft factual fingerprint for studying factual retention under stylistic variation, not as a general-purpose factuality metric.
